content.what_it_is: Python (numpy/matplotlib) port of the vessel_flat_bottom snapshot plot for FUNWAVE-TVD postprocessing. Unlike the workshop scripts with hardcoded user paths, it locates the run output portably via HOME = os.environ['HOME'] and fdir = $HOME/FUNWAVE-TVD/simple_cases/vessel_flat_bottom/work/output (L11-L12). It loads eta_00001 for grid sizing (L13-L14, L17), builds x,y with dx=dy=1.0 (L18-L22), selects snapshots nfile=[20, 40] with labels sec=['20','40'] (L24-L25), creates an 8x5-inch, 200-dpi figure (L28-L32), and per snapshot (L34-L51): loads eta_<fnum> (L35-L37), draws pcolor with coolwarm colormap in stacked subplots (L39-L41), titles 'Time = <sec> sec' with tight axes (L43-L45), labels Y/X, adds an eta (m) colorbar, and clamps clim(-1.5, 1.5) (L47-L51). Saves eta_flat_vessel.png (L53).
entities: script (no function/class definitions; top-level Python script)
HOME — user home directory from environment (L11)
fdir — run output directory under HOME (L12)
eta — surface elevation, sizing load then per snapshot (L14, L37)

equations.expr: x = np.asarray([float(xa)*dx for xa in range(m)])
